"""
@ingroup UTILITY_API
@brief Replace the image on a graphic style. All colorways that share this style are updated.
The chosen anchor point on the original graphic stays fixed in world space after replacement.

@param _graphicstyleIndex: index of the style to replace
@param _imagePath: path to the new image file
@param _anchor: anchor point to hold fixed. Accepts plain integers or Marvelous::CloApiAnchorPoint enum values:
0=Center  1=Up  2=RightUp  3=Right  4=RightDown
5=Down  6=LeftDown  7=Left  8=LeftUp
@return true if successful

@example anchor = CLOAPI_ANCHOR_LEFT_UP — wide logo replaced by tall logo, top-left pinned:

BEFORE                        AFTER
8─────────────────2           8──2  <- top-left (8) same world position
│                 │           │  │
│    OLD LOGO     │    -->    │  │
│                 │           │  │
6─────────────────4           │  │
6──4

@example anchor = CLOAPI_ANCHOR_CENTER (0) — also preserves original display size:

BEFORE                        AFTER
┌─────────────────┐           ┌─────────────────┐
│    OLD LOGO     │    -->    │    NEW LOGO     │  <- same size, center unmoved
└─────────────────┘           └─────────────────┘

@example anchor = CLOAPI_ANCHOR_RIGHT_DOWN — bottom-right corner pinned:

BEFORE                        AFTER
8─────────────────2                  8──2
│                 │                  │  │
│    OLD LOGO     │    -->            │  │
│                 │                  │  │
6─────────────────4           ───────6──4  <- bottom-right (4) same world position

"""
